key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 financial performance deteriorated significantly: net turnover decreased 29.6% to EUR 11.1 million, gross profit fell 66.5% to EUR 1.2 million, and the company reported a net loss of EUR 1.4 million (compared to a profit of EUR 0.9 million in Q1 2025).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Unaudited net turnover for Q1 2026: EUR 11.1 million (-29.6% YoY); gross profit: EUR 1.2 million (-66.5% YoY); unaudited net result: loss of EUR 1.4 million (Q1 2025: profit of EUR 0.9 million).

key_information_units.information: Sales volume plummeted by 36.1% to 517,600 9-liter cases in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025, representing a major period-over-period decline and a key driver of the turnover drop.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales volume, in 9 liter boxes: 517,600 (Q1 2026) vs. 810,079 (Q1 2025), a 36.1% decrease.

key_information_units.information: Performance decline was primarily driven by three external factors: loss of control over Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian confiscation of the Talvis distillery; and a global spirits market downturn, compounded by delayed excise tax payments that led to bank account freezes.
key_information_units.source_evidence: In January 2026, a trustee was appointed for Stoli Group (USA), LLC; Russian authorities designated related entities as 'extremist' and confiscated the Group-owned Talvis distillery; global spirits market downturn; delayed excise tax payments caused SRS to freeze bank accounts.

key_information_units.information: The company initiated Legal Protection Proceedings (LPP) in January 2026 (court-approved in February) to restructure liabilities and stabilize operations; the deadline for the LPP action plan was later extended to October 2026, with legal effects remaining in force until August 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Filed LPP application on 30 January 2026, approved on 5 February 2026; court set initial plan deadline of 5 June 2026, later extended to 5 October 2026; legal consequences remain until 5 August 2026.

key_information_units.information: The LPP filing automatically triggered an event of default under the Principal Shareholder's (Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l.) bond documentation, which in turn triggered events of default under its bank financing arrangements.
key_information_units.source_evidence: The filing of the LPP application also automatically triggered an event of default for Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l. under the terms of its issued bond documentation. This, in turn, automatically triggered events of default by the Principal Shareholder under its financing arrangements with banks.

key_information_units.information: Subsequent to the report period, in April 2026 the Principal Shareholder initiated judicial reorganization proceedings (réorganisation judiciaire) in Luxembourg, receiving a four-month moratorium until August 2026, during which enforcement actions against bondholders are suspended.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Pursuant to the judgment of the Luxembourg District Court sitting in commercial matters dated 24 April 2026, Amber Beverage Group Holding S.à r.l. has been authorized to initiate judicial reorganization proceedings; the Court has granted the Principal Shareholder a four-month moratorium until 24 August 2026, which suspends enforcement actions and collateral enforcement.

key_information_units.information: Operational efficiency indicators showed mixed results: the Right First Time (RFT) rate improved to 99.5% (Q1 2025: 98.4%), but the On Time In Full (OTIF) rate declined sharply to 70.3% (Q1 2025: 97.5%).

Management is conducting an additional assessment of doubtful receivables provisions established in prior periods and strengthening the finance function as part of governance enhancements to ensure financial stability.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Continuing initiatives to improve internal processes: additional assessment of provisions for doubtful receivables established in 2025 and prior periods; strengthening finance function with new accounting and finance professionals.
